repos_data.description: ⌘⌘ - A lightweight, native macOS screenshot tool that lives in your menu bar. Double-tap ⌘ Command to capture any region of your screen — instantly copied to clipboard, or annotate first with pen and mosaic tools.
Video wallpapers for macOS, from your own videos or Wallpaper Engine's Steam Workshop — picked from System Settings' Wallpaper pane
Free macOS menu bar app to visualize and clean developer caches (Xcode, node_modules, CocoaPods, SPM, Docker, pip, Cargo). Reclaim disk space instantly.

Mac lyrics app: word-by-word synced lyrics for Apple Music, Spotify, YouTube Music, QQ Music, NetEase Cloud Music, Kugou and more. Floating desktop lyrics, notch / Dynamic Island, menu bar and Touch Bar; translation, romanization, Last.fm scrobbling, Discord. Open-source LyricsX alternative. | Mac 桌面歌词：QQ音乐、网易云、酷狗、洛雪音乐逐字歌词，灵动岛、翻译、粤拼，LyricsX 替代
 Three-finger trackpad gestures for middle-click and middle-drag on macOS

Free, open-source menu bar toolkit for macOS. Eighteen tools in one panel: Pomodoro timer, time tracker, keep-awake, system monitor, clipboard history, file converter, window manager, torrents, archives, OCR, screenshots, draw on screen, color picker, VPN switcher, app launcher, uninstaller, keyboard lock, speed test. SwiftUI, no telemetry, MIT.

macOS menu-bar app for fine-grained VPN routing: bypass the VPN for chosen domains/services, force others through it, or (Custom mode) route each domain/subnet out a specific egress — direct, a specific VPN, an HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy, or a Tailscale peer. Includes a vpnb CLI.
Native Codex account switcher by Zhao Liu (liuzhao1225) for macOS and Windows. Local accounts, weekly/5h usage, confirmed Desktop switching.
Free, open-source screenshot tool, screen recorder, and video editor for Mac. Auto-zoom, smooth cursor, captions, OCR, scrolling capture, and annotations. Native, private, no account.
Stop forgetting brew update && brew upgrade. A menu bar app that keeps your Homebrew packages fresh — automatic checks, one-click updates, zero terminal required.
Screen translation app for macOS — select any area, get instant translation. On-device by default with Apple Vision OCR + Apple Translation.
Never keep an agent waiting. A free, open-source Mac menu bar app for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor: see which session needs you and answer it with one keystroke.
Minimalist macOS OCR tool. Open-source, privacy-first, and built with SwiftUI.
Free & open-source macOS menu bar app to track stocks, ETFs, crypto & portfolio P&L in real-time. Native SwiftUI, no account, no subscription, privacy-first.
🙈 macOS menu bar utility to hide the notch and round screen corners
Fast, private push-to-talk dictation for Apple Silicon Macs — local Parakeet TDT v3, no cloud or telemetry.
See what your Mac is doing and keep its battery healthy with a charge limit. Free, open source and native.
Menu bar app that finds and frees the disk space dev build artifacts and caches hog on macOS. Free, open source, notarized, zero telemetry.
Source-available voice dictation for macOS, free for personal use. On-device WhisperKit transcription with optional LLM cleanup.
Free, open source Mac menu bar app for memory and disk. See what uses your RAM, keep a week of history, pause idle apps, find large files, and uninstall cleanly. No network access.

One hotkey to ask any AI on Mac. Open-source menu bar assistant: press ⌥Space to ask with your own API key (OpenAI, Claude, any OpenAI-compatible), act on selected text, or send it to ChatGPT, Perplexity or a local CLI agent. Native Swift.
Mac menu-bar app: AirPods posture coaching and head-gesture shortcuts. On-device, no camera, no cloud.
📊 macOS menu bar system monitor with retro CRT aesthetics
Native macOS menu bar app — tmux session manager, Keep Awake / closed-lid mode (lid shut, work running), long-running script launcher (OCI polling, capacity wait, backups). Swift + SwiftUI.
Copy 2FA codes on your Mac with one shortcut: verification codes from Mail and Messages plus a built-in TOTP/HOTP authenticator. Free, open source, no internet access.
S.M.A.R.T. health, temperature and performance of your Mac's internal and external drives. Native macOS app, no network.
A macOS menu bar utility that automatically prevents screen lock when connected to your home WiFi network
Free live 4K wallpapers for Mac: about 590 space and nature loops plus Apple Aerials. Native SwiftUI, no account, no tracking.
Free, open-source Razer Synapse alternative for the Naga V2 HyperSpeed on macOS: remap all 12 side buttons, set DPI and polling rate.
Live, on-device transcription of any app on your Mac, with speaker names.
Tapflow / 点流 — macOS menu bar app that serves customizable touch panels to iPad browsers. Tap points, flowing keys.
Native macOS menu bar app showing Claude Code usage (session / weekly / Sonnet / credits) — no backend, notarized, brew install
NotchMuse v0.8.0: synced macOS lyrics for Spotify, Apple Music, NetEase, QQ Music and Soda Music. Menu bar, notch, side and Dock lyrics with in-app updates.
A lightweight macOS menu bar app focused on memory monitoring for multiple users
Remap keys, mouse buttons and trackpad gestures to shortcuts and macOS actions. Free, open source and native.
Show Desktop for Mac: hide every window with one click or ⌃⇧D, then bring them all back exactly as they were. The Windows+D shortcut for macOS. Free, open source, no internet access.

mFix: the Mac, fixed. Windows 11 window management for macOS 26: Snap Layouts, Snap Assist, Win+Arrow snapping, an Alt+Tab switcher with live window thumbnails, a Dock that acts like the taskbar, Explorer keys in Finder and Always on Top.
Screenshots by Ciro Cesar Maciel: an open screenshot and screen recording app for the Mac, in the spirit of CleanShot X. Native Swift, no network code.
Miss what worked in Windows? Dock window lists, Flip 3D ⌘Tab and snapping in one free, open-source Mac app.
Self-hosted photo backup for Mac — syncs your Photos library to a server you own over resumable uploads.
Your GitHub pull requests and Actions in the MacBook notch.
Free Ubuntu-style screenshot app for macOS: drag a selection, mark it up, blur, copy text, or grab a window or the whole screen.
Free, open-source AI meeting notes for Mac: transcribes any call and writes the minutes on your Mac. No bot, no cloud, no account.
Free macOS menu-bar file converter: drag files, tap Shift, drop on a petal. HEIC/WebP/AVIF/PDF, MP4/MOV/GIF, audio, EPUB, OCR, compress, trim, annotate. Apple Silicon.

Free, open-source macOS disk cleaner and disk space analyzer for developers — a CleanMyMac/DaisyDisk alternative. Clean Xcode, Docker, simulators, node_modules and 40+ caches from the menu bar, and see every gigabyte in a 2D/3D treemap.
Snap, resize and move macOS windows with trackpad gestures on their title bars. Free and open source.

Be present. Reprise remembers. An open-source call recorder for macOS: it notices calls in Zoom, Meet, Teams, FaceTime and more, and records both sides at about 1% CPU, and the screen if you want, to plain files. It keeps the call through a lost mic, a new headset or a crash. Native Swift, no dependencies, MIT.
Scoped Calendar and Reminders access for scripts and AI agents on your Mac: a menu bar app with an MCP server, per-client grants and approvals.
A small Mac menu bar app that checks every MCP server your AI agents use: broken, slow, waiting for a sign-in, or set up differently.

Automatic sample-rate switching for Apple Music and Tidal on Mac: lossless and hi-res play bit-perfect up to 192 kHz, no exclusive mode needed. Plus volume control for DACs that ignore the Mac and a per-device AutoEq / PEQdB headphone EQ. Free, open source, macOS 15+.
Your network companion in the macOS menu bar: know when your internet drops.
macOS clipboard manager in the menu bar. Keep copy history on your Mac, pick an item with a shortcut — no account, no network.
Toggle macOS dark mode and prevent sleep from the menu bar without opening System Settings — plus clean mode and mouse scroll.
Free pitch shifter for Mac: change the pitch of Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube or any app, live, without changing the tempo. Menu-bar app, macOS 14.4+.
A keyboard-first clipboard history popup in your menu bar that filters as you type and pastes on Return.
